title: Can the team at Pinnacle accommodate last minute changes or cancellations in Occupational Therapy sessions?
metaTitle: Last Minute Changes or Cancellations in Occupational Therapy Sessions - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Discover how Pinnacle Blooms Network accommodates last-minute changes or cancellations in Occupational Therapy sessions. Learn about our flexible approach to scheduling appointments.
html: Yes, at Pinnacle we understand that unexpected situations happen. Please feel free to contact our front desk or your child’s therapist directly as soon as possible to reschedule or cancel appointments.
